image_description: A low-angle close-up of a teal/blue street sign mounted on a grey metal pole against a blue sky with clouds. The sign features white text that appears distorted and illegible ('I WOFSIT' or similar gibberish) and a circular symbol on the right side that is also malformed. The mounting hardware (brackets) is visible but appears slightly fused or structurally ambiguous.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text is completely illegible and structurally nonsensical. Letters merge into each other, have inconsistent baselines, and include non-character shapes. This is a catastrophic failure for a 'street sign' class which relies on text.
The circular symbol on the right dissolves into a spiral/melting pattern rather than maintaining a crisp geometric edge expected of printed signage.
The brackets attaching the sign to the pole appear overly thick and lack clear mechanical logic (bolts/screws are missing or blurred), suggesting minor structural hallucination.
